text:
Alex: Heads up — after the merge of PR #4382 we've got a noticeable perf regression on small-batch, long-seq traffic. Latency median +18% and a bunch of cold compiles reported. Possibly the selector heuristic swung to a new kernel for those shapes.
Riley: Ugh. Saw CI perf alert for the runtime e2e. Can you paste the failing job link? :eyes:
Alex: https://ci.redwood.com/jobs/12345 (perf-e2e/throughput). The job timeline shows a compile spike ~02:14 UTC and then KV cache churn. Flame graph attached in the job artifacts.
Sam: CI bot also posted the perf diff summary in the job. @Alex can you repro locally with a small harness? If yes we should bisect quickly.
Alex: Repro is pretty stable on my devbox. Repro command:
```
./run_perf_harness --model llama-13b --batch-sizes 1,2 --seq-len 1024 --profile=compile
```
Logs show repeated `compile_kernel(module=attn_v2,schema=small)` and then `kvcache:evict(prefix=...)`
Jordan: If the selector moved to choose attn_v2_rust instead of attn_v1_cuda for these shapes that's a bad regression. Do we have the autotune table snapshot from before the merge?
Alex: I grabbed the autotune table from canary yesterday: autotune_snapshot/2026-10-11-09.tgz. New merge writes a new policy to /etc/redwood/kernel_selector/policy.json at startup. Diff looks like it bumped score for v2 on seq>=512.
Riley: Can you try forcing the legacy policy to confirm rollback avoids the regression? env override should be quick.
Alex: Tried `REDWOOD_KERNEL_POLICY=legacy ./run_perf_harness` — latency back to baseline and compile wave disappears. So it's definitely the policy change.
Sam: CI job shows same — rerun with env override passed and job green. We need a revert candidate or a fix to the scoring function. I'd prefer revert for immediate rollback (rollouts blocked).
Alex: Git bisect points at commit 3f2b7a6b (merge: feature/selector-tuning) as introducing the scoring change. Patch is small — heuristic change in selector/score.cc.
Jordan: Plan: create emergency revert PR for 3f2b7a6b, run a canary in prod (10% traffic) and smoke. If canary passes, ramp. Also add a fast unit/regression test in autotune harness to catch selector swings.
Sam: I'll open the revert PR and add a note to the release that rollout blocked until CI perf regression cleared. Assigning to @Sam for the revert and @Alex for the autotune test.
ci-bot: perf-e2e job 12345 marked failing at 1842004400. Re-run queued with env override: job 12346.
Alex: Also adding a short-term mitigation: set `autotune_cache_ttl_seconds=600` to reduce aggressive re-eval. Not ideal long-term but helps.
Riley: Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread. Once revert PR is up ping #eng-releases and I'll coordinate the rollout.
Sam: Revert PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4390 — include unit test + description. Starting canary now.
Jordan: Canary started (10% traffic). Monitoring dash: https://dash.redwood.com/selector/compare/3f2b7a6b
Alex: Canary looks good at +0.5% median. If stable for 15m we'll full-roll.
Riley: Good work. After full roll, please schedule a postmortem and add a regression test to CI that samples policy scores across shapes to prevent future silent swings. :thumbsup:
